purpose: Production contract for Deadline Zero biome environment art.

runtimePolicy.releaseGoal: all 70 biome-specific slots authored and present in art/game.atlas

biomes.palette: cold industrial steel, emergency red, dirty concrete
molten orange, furnace red, black steel
violet void energy, electric cyan, black alloy
clean ice blue, white frost, dark navy steel
deep cyan, frozen teal, abyssal blue

sourceGuidance.style: premium top-down sci-fi survival, physically readable materials, no text, no logos
sourceGuidance.lighting: baked local material lighting only; preserve readability under runtime tint and local-light FX
sourceGuidance.silhouetteRule: props must remain readable at approximately 32-96 screen pixels
sourceGuidance.floorRule: floor tiles must be seamless and low-contrast enough not to compete with enemies/projectiles
sourceGuidance.decalRule: decals need clean transparent edges and must not contain baked rectangular backgrounds
